integrity: Harmonic fusion-plane construction and block formula credited to Fickus et al.; original result claimed only for the new spectral characterizations and their sharpness. Checker relies on the Python standard library and enumerates all subsets.
scientific_limitations: Universal three-block statement for real quadratic-character harmonic planes with q congruent to 1 modulo 4; exhaustive four-block result only at q=13. The four-block theorem uses a complete finite exact-arithmetic certificate. Independent novelty assessment and mathematical audit are not supplied.
title: Three-block rigidity and the four-block spectral profile of real Paley harmonic fusion planes
